text:
maya: Quick sync 1 — launch webinar + benchmark article in 2 weeks. Need a tight SEO handoff: KW priorities, schema snippets, internal hub links, safe redirects, and UTM mapping for lead routing.

 tom: I'll own keyword clustering + anchor text plan. Focusing on "LLM inference latency" and "cost per token inference" buckets. Will share 8-10 high-priority KW groups.

 rachel: I'll draft Event + FAQ schema for the webinar page and Article schema for the benchmark. Will include registration url and timezone.

 aj: I'll implement redirects and canonical tags. Keep rewrites minimal and temporary. Propose these NGINX rules: 

 ```
 rewrite ^/old-launch$ /announcements/launch-2026 permanent;
 rewrite ^/bench-old/(.*)$ /benchmarks/launch-2026/$1 permanent;
 ```

 tom: For internal linking: create /resources/llm-performance as hub. Hub -> benchmark -> methods -> pricing -> signup. Use exact-match KW once per page then variations. Keep depth <=2.

 rachel: Schema example (Event):

 ```json
 {
   "@context": "https://schema.org",
   "@type": "Event",
   "name": "Redwood Inference: Launch & Benchmark",
   "startDate": "2026-06-10T17:00:00-07:00",
   "location": {"@type": "VirtualLocation","url": "https://redwood.example.com/webinar?utm_campaign=launch_jun"},
   "offers": {"@type": "Offer","url": "https://redwood.example.com/register?utm_campaign=launch_jun"}
 }
 ```

 aj: I'll add canonical tags on the blog templates and check robots.txt to avoid accidental blocking.

 maya: UTM rules: append utm_source=webinar, utm_campaign=launch_jun, utm_medium=webinar. Map region field on form to Sales queues (APAC/EMEA/NAM).

 tom: KW sheet posted: https://docs.example.com/sheets/kw-launch-2625 — anchor map included.

 aj: PR opened for redirects and canonical updates: https://git.example.com/redwood/www/merge_requests/378

 dev-bot: link-scan: started on https://staging.redwood.example.com/announcements/launch-2026 — 2 warnings (images not lazy-loaded). Report: /ci/reports/scan-2625

 rachel: Adding a short CLI snippet for the benchmark post (sample only):

 ```bash
 redwood-bench --model rwd-7b --seq 1024 --batch 4 --runs 8
 ```

 maya: Timeline: KW + anchors by EOD today, schema by tomorrow, redirect PR by Thu, content freeze Mon for dry-run. Tag PRs here when ready. :rocket:
